summary: 15+ years of experience as an HR Classification/Compensation Lead and HR Specialist, managing recruitment, compensation, classification, training, and policy development across multi-state and statewide initiatives.

experience.title: HR Specialist
responsibilities: Managed full‑cycle recruitment for multi‑state needs.
Ensured candidate qualifications matched KSAs.
Completed pre‑employment processes (background checks, drug screens, reference checks).
Conducted onboarding and orientation.
Performed initial phone screens and recommended applicants for on‑site interviews.
Contacted candidates with salary/hourly wage offers.
Negotiated start dates.

experience.title: HR Analyst
responsibilities: Analyzed 50+ roles (250+ positions) within 10 months.
Developed and implemented classification and level‑based system for IT, Security, and Radiation classes.
Conducted labor‑market studies and recommended compensation practices.
Reviewed, approved, and referred candidates for management selection.
Managed budget interactions for salary adjustments.
Reviewed and approved salary adjustments and status determinations.

experience.title: Manager, Classification/Compensation
responsibilities: Reduced job analysis timeframe from four months to 11 days.
Established project management templates and communication plans.
Prioritized and assigned classification and compensation studies.
Coordinated recruitment of referrals from state officials.
Conducted statewide FLSA evaluations for appropriate designations.
Ensured legal and justified salary administration practices.

experience.title: Manager, Recruitment/Classification/Compensation
responsibilities: Eliminated backlog of classification/compensation studies within four months.
Supervised recruitment for all occupational needs of the hospital.
Reviewed requests for occupational and individual position studies.
Implemented competency and skill‑based pay programs for nurses, mechanical trades, and institutional services.

experience.title: Senior HR Analyst
responsibilities: Oversaw HR classification/compensation activities for 12 field managers and analysts.
Managed statewide competency‑based pay programs for nurses.
Qualified applicants and approved salary exceptions and adjustments.
Led statewide FLSA designation analysis for 18,000 employees.
Processed reduction‑in‑force activities.
Developed and delivered training on regulations, laws, and policies.
Ensured performance management initiatives were met.

experience.title: Senior HR Analyst
responsibilities: Facilitated development of statewide policies for competency and skill‑based pay.
Partnered with managers to create technical and soft‑skills CBPs.
Managed statewide skill‑based pay program for machine operators.

experience.title: Training And Development Specialist
responsibilities: Assessed educational/training needs.
Developed, delivered, and evaluated leadership, technical, and administrative training.
Led statewide initiatives such as performance‑based pay and evaluations.
Contributed to research on ethical practice of trainers.
